name: infinite-scroll-status
title: Infinite scroll status
description: The footer of an auto-loading list: it asks for the next page near the viewport, then shows loading, an error with Retry, or the end.
docs: Place it after the last item. Set loading while a page is being fetched: that is what lets it ask again when the new page still leaves it in view. When the list scrolls inside a box, pass that box as root so rootMargin applies to it. A Load more button stays visible as the fallback for keyboard users and browsers without IntersectionObserver; pressing it, or Retry, keeps keyboard focus in the footer while the page comes. Pass count (and total) to have what each page added announced.
